big: Owning an office building means a big cheque, one tenant risk and a long wait to sell. A REIT lets you own a slice of the rent from many buildings, through a listed unit you can buy from a small amount.

lines: So I own a part of an office park?
Not exactly. A REIT is a trust that owns rent-earning property. Your unit is a share in the trust's cash flows, not a claim on any one building. Most of the rent is passed on to unitholders.

alt: Four steps from tenant rent to unitholder payout
caps: Tenants pay rent for office parks and malls.
Most is passed on, as per the rules.
